description: Build the first reliable Mission Control MVP in Vibey Manage using BullMQ as control plane and OpenClaw as execution plane with 3 agents (manager, copywriter, designer).

context.currentProblem: Nexus-style multi-agent execution is not reliable enough (cron-only heartbeats, weak retry/timeout/idempotency), and Vibey Manage has no mission control flow yet.
context.desiredState: A user can submit a mission in Manage, the queue dispatches manager then worker reliably, progress is visible in UI, retries are automatic, and completed output is persisted.
context.architectureGoal: Keep agents in OpenClaw and add reliability in BullMQ/NestJS with mission state machine, idempotency, timeout, and correlation IDs end-to-end, while enforcing Controller->Service->Repository boundaries, feature isolation, and standard guard/validation patterns.

userStories.title: Create mission domain schema
userStories.description: As the system, I need mission tables and state fields so mission lifecycle is persisted and queryable.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase migration creates missions table with status enum-like constraint: queued, dispatching, running, done, failed, dead_letter
Supabase migration creates org_agents table with seeded agents: manager, copywriter, designer
Supabase migration creates mission_logs table linked to mission_id for timeline events
missions includes idempotency_key and correlation_id fields
RLS or ownership rules are aligned with current user-scoped manage model
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Keep schema minimal for MVP; avoid dead-letter UI schema complexity beyond required fields.

userStories.title: Add API module for missions and org agents
userStories.description: As the Manage frontend, I need mission APIs to create, list, view, and track missions.
acceptanceCriteria: NestJS module created in apps/api for missions with routes for create mission, list missions, get mission detail, and mission logs
Controller methods use guard pattern consistent with backend modules: AuthGuard + RoleGuard (+ ThrottlerGuard if used in module) with power/admin access
All request bodies, params, and query inputs in new endpoints use Zod DTO validation (via ZodValidationPipe or existing project equivalent)
Create mission endpoint generates correlation_id and idempotency_key
API persists mission with initial status queued and enqueues queue job trigger contract payload
Endpoint for internal progress callback exists for agent/worker updates to mission status and logs
Code follows strict layering: controllers handle HTTP only, services contain business logic, repositories/integrations contain data/external IO
Feature isolation is preserved: new mission APIs and services do not modify unrelated feature modules
Manage role guard behavior matches existing power/admin pattern
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Reuse existing backend auth conventions from tasks/users modules.

userStories.title: Implement queue missions processor
userStories.description: As the platform, I need BullMQ to reliably dispatch mission jobs to OpenClaw and manage retries/timeouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue worker adds MissionsModule and processor for mission dispatch jobs
Queue worker module follows backend architecture layering (controller/trigger -> service logic -> integration client access as applicable)
Processor transitions mission statuses through queued -> dispatching -> running -> done|failed|dead_letter
Processor calls OpenClaw gateway chat completions endpoint with mission session key and correlation metadata
Job timeout is enforced at 5 minutes for MVP
Retries use existing BullMQ configuration (3 attempts, exponential backoff) and persist retry_count/log events
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Control plane owns reliability; OpenClaw remains execution plane.

userStories.title: Register and configure three OpenClaw agents
userStories.description: As the execution layer, I need manager/copywriter/designer agents to run with distinct roles and tool scopes.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenClaw config includes manager, copywriter, and designer agents
Each agent has dedicated workspace path and role prompt/skills reference
Session key pattern includes user_id and mission_id for isolation
Manager prompt includes explicit routing rule between copywriter and designer based on request type
Agents can post progress/completion through internal callback endpoint contract
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: No NeuralSnap brain integration in MVP.

userStories.title: Support manager to worker delegation
userStories.description: As a manager agent, I need to create worker sub-missions so routing is real and observable.
acceptanceCriteria: Manager can create a child mission for copywriter OR designer via internal API/queue contract
Child mission references parent mission id
Mission logs show delegation decision event with selected worker agent
Parent mission status waits for child result and then finalizes
Failure in child mission is surfaced to parent mission with reason
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Single level delegation only in MVP.

userStories.title: Build Manage mission inbox UI
userStories.description: As a power/admin user, I need a mission inbox to submit tasks and view statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: Manage page contains quick capture input to create mission
Mission list shows status chips and latest updated time
Mission row displays assigned/current agent when available
Frontend feature structure follows project architecture: smart container in feature containers and presentational pieces in feature components
No cross-feature imports are introduced; shared logic uses lib/ or shared components per project architecture
User-facing text in this feature follows Vibey voice and is centralized in feature message config where appropriate
UI handles loading/empty/error states consistently with existing Manage components
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: MVP UI can live under a new Manage route (mission control) without replacing current dashboard.

visualVerification.lookFor: Mission quick capture input, mission list rows with status, and no broken layout in Manage shell.

userStories.title: Show mission detail and timeline
userStories.description: As a user, I need to inspect mission progress and output to trust autopilot behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Mission detail view shows summary, current status, and final output
Timeline shows mission_logs entries in descending time order
Timeline includes queue events, delegation events, and completion/failure events
Retry count and failure reason are visible when applicable
User-facing labels/messages in mission detail follow Vibey voice conventions
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: No dead-letter operation controls yet; read-only visibility is enough.

visualVerification.lookFor: Selecting a mission reveals detailed timeline and output panel.

userStories.title: Add agent status panel for three agents
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see whether manager/copywriter/designer are online, idle, or working.
acceptanceCriteria: Mission control page shows 3 agent cards: manager, copywriter, designer
Each card displays current status (online/idle/working/offline) from backend data
Card status updates without full page reload (polling or existing realtime pattern)
Agent panel labels/tooltips follow feature message config + Vibey voice conventions
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Keep status source simple; no full health dashboard in MVP.

visualVerification.lookFor: Three agent cards with clearly distinguishable status indicators.

userStories.title: Enforce idempotency and correlation tracing
userStories.description: As operators, we need duplicate protection and traceability across API, queue, gateway, and logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate create requests with same idempotency_key do not create duplicate missions
correlation_id is persisted and propagated through mission, queue job payload, and gateway request metadata
mission_logs contain correlation_id for every lifecycle event
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: MVP can use DB uniqueness on idempotency_key scoped by user.

userStories.title: Validate MVP success path and retry path
userStories.description: As the team, we need proof that the happy path and controlled failure path both work end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Happy path test: mission routes manager -> copywriter and completes with visible output in UI
Happy path test: mission routes manager -> designer and completes with visible output in UI
Failure path test: simulated worker failure triggers retries and final status is visible
Simple mission completes within 60 seconds in local/dev environment target
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: This story is the MVP gate; do not expand scope before this passes.
